provenance: Production implementation is independent. Development conformance includes original cases and statically imported upstream fixtures. See conformance/upstreams.json, import-inventory.json, and NOTICE.md for pinned provenance, exclusions, and retained licenses.

statusMeaning.partial: Implemented for the documented subset, with tests; complete parity is not claimed.
statusMeaning.deferred: Not implemented; unsupported syntax is rejected. Options absent from our API are not accepted as configuration.

syntax.identifiers: ASCII letter/underscore followed by word characters or hyphens
syntax.lookups: Variable-rooted and bare context bracket access; computed lookup indices; sequence length/size and record size fallback; literal receiver indexing deferred
syntax.expressions: Literals, ranges, comparisons, contains, not, right-associated and/or, filter pipelines; opt-in parenthesized conditions and pipelines
syntax.partials: Literal or variable template names, interpolated quoted filenames, with/for/as bindings, and comma-separated named arguments.
syntax.loops: limit, numeric offset, reversed, else, and offset:continue

hostValues.plainRecords: supported with own data properties only

differences.behavior: Defaults true; unknown filter failures occur during rendering rather than parsing.
Accepts trimmed endraw delimiters that the pinned oracle rejects.
Finite limits with typed errors and cancellation checkpoints; units/defaults are independent of LiquidJS.
Rejected rather than silently overwriting an earlier expression.
Rejects non-arrays, including short strings and array-like records accepted by the pinned oracle.
Rejected by the finite Liquid value boundary instead of printing Infinity/NaN.

api.analyzeProject: implemented for bounded render dependencies; include summaries are partial
api.typedTemplates: tagged templates with typed external paths and render context; raw Liquid checked separately
api.schema: decoded structural projection; recursive/opaque shapes are partial
api.customFilters: Effect registry preserves typed errors and service requirements
api.browser: core bundle verified; no Node adapters imported by parser
api.cli: local parse/analyze/render/check; filesystem project CLI deferred
